fusions.name: Repeater Latch
fusions.desc: A lever-fed crossbow looses a bolt at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Cranked Battery
fusions.desc: After a 1.5 second crank, releases 4 heavy quarrels in a spread out to 8 tiles, each of which deals 25 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Windlass Sentry
fusions.desc: Sets up a ballista for 15 seconds. It deals 5 damage to an enemy within 6 tiles every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Fully Wound
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
